why: v2 is v1 with the listed edits, and with 30 comment lines put in front of every JavaScript file (the helper modules in config/, ipc/ and lib/ included). Eight edits change what the program does: a channel and its bridge member are renamed (edits 1 and 2), a bridge member and with it the only sender of a channel is deleted (3), the widget loses its sandbox override (4), the shared window defaults turn context isolation off (5), the API base address moves from v3 to v4 (6), a settings key is added (7) and a database clean-up is deleted (8). Two edits change nothing a tool should report: edit 9 swaps two neighbouring members of the exposed API, edit 10 rewrites a channel name inside a comment. The comment lines move every other fact to a new line without changing it.
